title: Topic 9: Numbers, Prices & Money - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Count, understand prices, handle money situations

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Shop flyer format
CASA BELA - BIG PRICES? NO! SMALL PRICES!
Bed ........ eighty dollars
Table ...... forty dollars
Chair ...... fifteen dollars
All very cheap!
We are in the city of Braga.
Monday to Saturday, nine o'clock to six o'clock.

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Ravi: Mama, I need money for school, please!
Mama: Why, Ravi?
Ravi: My new English book is twenty dollars.
Mama: Twenty? OK, that is not expensive. And your
      brother's book?
Ravi: His book is thirty dollars!
Mama: Thirty?! OK, OK. I pay for the two books.
